```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
# Browser cache key, derived from the database's own bytes.
#
# It used to be the release tag:
#     "multised-merged@v0.5.0"
# That was wrong. The database is re-uploaded onto the EXISTING release rather
# than tagged afresh, so the tag does not move when the file changes, and every
# returning visitor went on serving the stale copy out of browser cache. That
# surfaces as "no such column" the moment a rebuild adds one. Hashing the file is
# exact by construction: same bytes, same key; new bytes, new key. The pre-render
# step guarantees the file is here before this runs.
ojs_define(
  dbCacheKey = paste0(
    "multised-merged@",
    substr(unname(tools::md5sum("multised_merged.sqlite")), 1, 12)
  )
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
db = {
  const StratumSQLite = await window._stratumSQLite;
  return StratumSQLite.open(window._dbMerged, {
    sqlJsPath: window._sqljsBase,
    cacheKey:  dbCacheKey,
  });
}
```
